name: layer3-collectioniq
description: Organize collectibles into named vaults and record estimated USD values from your own records or appraisals. Add item details, filter a collection and record value updates during the current widget session. Items with no supplied estimate stay unpriced, and zero-dollar estimates are preserved. CollectionIQ does not provide appraisals, photo recognition, comparable sales or market-price history. Keep a copy of your collection before closing the widget.

defaultPrompt: Open CollectionIQ for a new collection.
Add a vintage watch with my $1,200 estimate to the Watches vault.
Add a trading card without an estimated value.

positive.prompt: Open CollectionIQ for a new collection.
positive.expected_behavior: Open an empty editable collection. No sample items, market prices or fabricated history.

positive.prompt: Add a Vintage Watch with my USD1,200 estimate in the Watches vault.
positive.expected_behavior: One item, Watches vault, USD1,200 supplied estimate and USD1,200 total.

positive.prompt: Add a Signed Print with my estimate of USD0.
positive.expected_behavior: One item with USD0 recorded estimate, not unpriced.

positive.prompt: Add a Trading Card without a value.
positive.expected_behavior: Keep the item unpriced. Unpriced count one. Do not invent an appraisal.

positive.prompt: Add a Fountain Pen, estimated USD125, vault Pens, description Blue resin body.
positive.expected_behavior: Display supplied name, description Blue resin body, Pens vault and USD125 estimate.

negative.prompt: Appraise this watch from a photo using live comparable sales.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim image analysis, live sales or a market appraisal. Explain the manual estimate requirement.

negative.prompt: Sell my collection and collect payment.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke CollectionIQ to perform a sale, transaction or payment.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, sales or automatic cancellation.

publication.release_notes: Repair tool inputs, text results and interactive UI. Use the shared HTTPS host, the MCP Apps bridge, explicit tool annotations and app-specific privacy disclosures. Remove unsupported data and account-action claims.
